sentences.text: Author: Shib Sadhan Sadhu Bench: Shib Sadhan Sadhu  1 13.02.2015 s.das CRR 419 of 2015 Mr. Ayan Bhattacherjee, Mr. Prasenjit Debnath ..... for the petitioner Heard the learned Counsel appearing for the petitioner and gone through the revisional application and materials annexed therein.

Let the matter be listed under the heading "Listed Motion"
after six weeks from date.

In the meantime, notice along with copy of the revision petition be served upon State through learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and an affidavit of service be filed on the next date of hearing of this matter.

There shall be order of stay of the proceedings being G.R. No. 340 of 2014 arising out of Nabadwip Police Station Case No. 343 of 2014 dated 06.06.2014 under Sections 269/270/272/120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 59/63 of the Food Standard and Safety Act, 2006, pending before the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge, Nabadwip, Nadia for a period of eight weeks from date or until further order, whichever is earlier.
